notes:
YLLW 0.5.3
- Light and dark mode: switch with the new sun and moon button next to Settings, or pick Light, Dark or Match system in Settings. Dark mode uses the YLLW yellow as its accent.
- Canvas color: pick the background behind the device panes in Settings under Look. Auto follows light or dark mode, or choose a preset or any color. Device names stay readable on any color.
- Hint text is a little easier to read in both modes.
